resources.string: Continue watching outside the app, in the launcher row.
Adds a \"Continue watching\" row of Nuvio to the Android TV home screen and fills the \"Play next\" row of the launcher.
What happens when you select an item of the launcher row.

The long-press menu of the launcher belongs to the system and cannot be changed: with \"Show menu\" the app opens straight on the options of the item (resume, choose source and play, details…). Some launchers, such as Google TV, may only show this row for certified apps.
